name: AI-Skill-Library
purpose: A provenance-first catalog and portable library of independently authored AI agent workflow guides.
not_done: The original host-managed bodies for the 148 catalog entries have not been exported. Portable guides are independent equivalents, not exact recovery of private/plugin-managed text.
147 of 155 portable guides are UNLICENSED. They are not approved for redistribution, bundling, hosted publication, or commercial use until an appropriate license is explicitly selected.
Host-specific CLI discovery, activation, invocation, and compatibility tests have not been run for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, and Grok Build.
The 1,550 routing prompts are seed fixtures only; no matched baseline-versus-skill runtime effectiveness report exists.
No comprehensive skill-level static and dynamic security assessment has been completed.
No root-level license has been selected for all original repository files.
No signed release package, SBOM, build provenance attestation, or signature verification procedure has been published.
Modern Web Guidance is catalogued as an external reference only; the upstream CLI has not been executed and its host-specific activation/invocation has not been tested as part of this repository.
principles: Do not redistribute proprietary/plugin-hosted skill bodies without rights.
Pin source commits and record Git object identifiers for published files.
Review each license at file/subtree level.
Scan and manually inspect before execution.
Measure skill lift against a matched baseline.
Use host adapters rather than forking canonical content.
Distinguish format validation from host runtime compatibility and task evaluation.
Do not declare commercial readiness while a release gate remains blocked.
upstream_policy: read_only_drift_scan_issue_notification_only; no automatic source pin or skill content updates
